gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-old-south-ar: Bellota's s has ends that swing wide open, and every stroke is traced as if by one stylus. And Noto Sans Old South Arabian reads smoothly over many lines, its curved strokes stopping before they turn inward.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-palanquin: Wire-bright and theatrical, Bellota cuts every stroke at a single depth, like an engraver's tool that never pressed harder. Palanquin's wide-mouthed curves keep the engraved heading company without crowding it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-pontano-sans: Pontano Sans moves along easily, with c terminals that open wide and invite the eye in. But Bellota keeps rounds and stems in a single weight, and that wiry consistency is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-quattrocento-sans: Punchy but pressure-free, Bellota has no brush-style swelling while Quattrocento Sans leaves enough gap that c never looks like o. Bellota belongs up large, in short bursts of text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-red-hat-text: Bellota arrives with wide-swinging s ends and a stylus-width line throughout. Red Hat Text then takes over with a technical-pen line and curvy, unclamped letters, so the page feels drafted from top to bottom.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans leaves a wide gap at the e's terminal and keeps its strokes uniform in every direction. And with Bellota's s ends flung wide above, paragraphs in this body type feel steady and unhurried.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-rethink-sans: Wiry and showy, Bellota flings its s ends wide, every stroke traced with one stylus. Yet Rethink Sans keeps its openings generous at every weight, which is what lets the pair breathe.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-rosario: Rosario lets the ends of its c stay open and never curl inward, a friendly, current look. And Bellota's constant-weight line, tracing each letter like wire, is the boldest move here.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-sarabun: Bellota's letters look light yet have no thinner parts, with s ends that swing wide. Sarabun, meanwhile, does the quiet work, sending a wide channel into every bowl while Bellota takes the spotlight.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-shanti: Bellota holds one track width throughout, like a neon sign tube, with s ends swinging wide. Shanti handles the sustained reading, with a generous entry into the e's eye, leaving Bellota the showy work.
